name: Husband Being The Spiritual Leader
overview: Scripture establishes the husband's role as the spiritual leader within the marriage, emphasizing his responsibility to lovingly lead his wife as Christ loved the church, even to the point of self-sacrifice (Ephesians 5:25). Wives are called to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting an order established since creation (Genesis 3:16; Ephesians 5:22). This leadership is exercised in mutual respect and reverence for God, as both husband and wife submit to one another out of the fear of the Lord (Ephesians 5:21). The husband's spiritual leadership involves internalizing God's commands (Deuteronomy 6:6) and modeling godly character, following God as beloved children (Ephesians 5:1).
